title: Dash mechanic — short-cooldown directional burst that breaks the grid-blocking norm
intent: Pure movement options today: walk + Kick (needs bomb on cell) + Throw Glove (needs canThrow pickup). Walk is the only universally-available movement, and it's grid-blocked by everything (hard blocks, soft blocks, bombs, opponent bombers). Adding a DASH — short-cooldown directional burst — gives every bomber an item-free escape verb + chase verb. Modern Bomberman-likes (Bombergrounds: Reborn) ship dash as a core movement primitive; the gap in Kaboom Crew is the most 'feels dated' missing feature post-multiplayer-shipped. Dash: press Shift + a direction → bomber moves 2 cells in that direction over 0.2s in an animated arc, passing THROUGH soft blocks + bombs + bombers (anything that normally blocks). Stops at hard blocks (the only thing dash respects). 3-second cooldown.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/competitor-analysis.md §3.2` (highest gameplay-feel uplift per LOC) + cross-reference to Bombergrounds Reborn (dash core to modern bomberman vocabulary) + Brawl Stars (dash + super combo familiar to mobile audiences). The current game tells players 'walk + place bomb' for movement; dash makes players say 'I can SOMETHING'. Closes a primary gap. Sized `should` because without it the game still functions; with it, the moment-to-moment feel jumps a tier.
acceptanceHints: examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
BomberStats gains optional dash fields:
dashCooldownRemaining?: number (default 0 — ready to use)
dashing?: boolean (default false — true during the 0.2s dash animation)
dashStartCell?: { gx, gz }
dashTargetCell?: { gx, gz }
dashElapsedMs?: number (during dash animation)
DashRequest transient: { dx, dz } — set by input system when player presses Shift + direction.
INPUT WIRING (examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/player-input-system.ts):
Shift + W/A/S/D (or arrows): writes DashRequest with the matching {dx, dz}. Falls through to normal walk input only if dash is not ready (cooldown > 0).
No alternative input — Shift is the dash modifier. Should not clash with browser default Shift-key behaviour (most browsers ignore Shift+arrow when canvas has focus).
Optional: agent probe `__agf.kaboom.requestDash(entityId, dx, dz)` for tests.
DASH SYSTEM (examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/dash-system.ts): NEW.
Consumes DashRequest. Validates: alive=true, dashCooldownRemaining<=0, not already dashing.

Compute dashTargetCell = bomber.gridPos + (dx, dz) × 2. If target is out-of-bounds OR HARD BLOCK on intermediate cell: scope DOWN to +1 cell (single-cell dash fallback). If +1 cell is also blocked by hard block: refuse the dash entirely (no cooldown burned).
Initiate dash: set bomber.dashing=true, dashStartCell=current, dashTargetCell=computed, dashElapsedMs=0. Set dashCooldownRemaining=3000ms.

Per fixedUpdate: while dashing, advance dashElapsedMs. Lerp bomber's Transform.position along an arc from dashStartCell → dashTargetCell over 200ms (200ms arc duration is configurable per-bomber but defaults uniform).
Arc shape: position goes +0.5 cell height at midpoint, returns to ground at landing. Visual 'jump-dash' read.
At dashElapsedMs >= 200: dashing=false, snap GridPosition to dashTargetCell, clear dash state.
Cooldown: decrement dashCooldownRemaining per fixedUpdate while !dashing. When reaches 0, ready again.
PASS-THROUGH RULES:
During dash animation, the bomber's GridOccupancy entry is REMOVED from the grid (the bomber is 'in the air'). Other entities don't block; the bomber doesn't block others.
Soft blocks, bombs, and opponent bombers in the intermediate path: bomber passes through. They are NOT destroyed by the dash — pure movement, no damage.
Hard blocks: dash refuses to start if a hard block is in the intermediate path (per validation step above).
Pickups in the path: collected on landing cell only (the cell where the dash ends). Intermediate cells skip pickup.

Blast tiles in the path: bomber dashing through a blast tile takes damage normally (dash doesn't grant invulnerability). The bomber's alive=false flip happens mid-dash; the dash visual continues to the landing cell, then death animation plays.
Sudden-death (GDP-2026-05-27-013) closing walls: dash treats them as hard blocks (refuses to start through them).
INTERACTIONS WITH OTHER MECHANICS:
Dash + Shield: shield preserves through dash. Dashing into a blast cell consumes shield (regular hit-recoil path), bomber lands alive.
Dash + Throw Glove: dash CAN'T be used while carrying a bomb (the bomb takes precedence; dash request is refused with no cooldown burned).
Dash + Remote: bomber can dash while having armed remote bombs. Doesn't trigger or affect them.
Dash + Conveyor (S146): dash lands on a belt cell → bomber is on the belt next tick, gets pushed normally. The belt doesn't act during the dash's mid-animation.
Dash + Warp (S149): dash lands on warp cell → bomber teleports next tick. Sequenced naturally.
HUD:

Power-up HUD icon grid from S148 gains a DASH slot (always present, since dash is universal). Icon shows a cooldown ring overlay — full ring = ready; partial ring = cooldown remaining. Pulsing glow when ready.
Visual cue: when dash is on cooldown, the cooldown ring fills counterclockwise as time progresses. Empty = ready. Standard cooldown UI.
AUDIO:
New event `dash` — short whoosh sound. Fires on dash start.
Voice synth: bomber's 'hit' vocal slot is NOT a fit (too aggressive). Add a new vocal slot 'dash' to GDP-022-008 backlog (not in scope for THIS story — silent dash voice is fine for v1).
BOT AI:

Bots get dash too. Bot decision tree gains a new action 'dash to safety' weighted high when own cell is in imminent danger AND a safe cell exists within dash range (2 cells in any cardinal direction).
Personality-aware: Coward uses dash more aggressively (defensive); Hunter uses it for chase; Miner uses it for soft-block traversal.
Bot dash decisions are throttled per personality (Coward: every 4s if needed; Hunter: every 6s; Miner: every 8s).
MULTIPLAYER (post-S125 server-authoritative):
Server validates DashRequest. Server runs dash-system, snapshots include dashing + dashElapsedMs state per bomber.
Client prediction: local player's dash animation starts immediately on input + reconciles to server confirmation in 1-2 snapshots. If server denies (e.g. cooldown desync), client snaps back.
Remote players' dashes: client interpolates the arc smoothly from the snapshot's start + target cells.
ANIMATION (post-S102 multi-mesh + S103 procedural anim):

Bench-animation-system (or its post-S104 kaboom analog) gains a new animation kind 'dash'. During dash: legs swing forward in unison (push-off pose), torso pitches forward 15°, arms extend behind for balance. Returns to walk-cycle / idle-bob at the dash's end.
The animation phase advances with dashElapsedMs (NOT distance, NOT wall-clock — dash is a discrete event).
ACCEPTANCE PLAYTEST:
Bomber on cell A, presses Shift+D → arcs 2 cells right → lands at cell A+2. Cooldown ring visible in HUD.
Bomber tries dash into a hard block → dash refused (audio NOT fires; cooldown unchanged).
Bomber dashes through a soft block → unblocked, lands beyond. Soft block NOT destroyed.
Bomber dashes through opponent bomber → unblocked.
Bomber dashes into a blast cell → lands → dies.
3 seconds after dash → cooldown ring full, ready again.
Bot vs bot test: Coward bot dashes away from imminent blasts; round resolves within existing budget.
UNIT TESTS:
Dash from (5,5) with Shift+D → lands at (7,5) in 200ms (sampled via 12 fixedUpdate ticks at 60Hz).
Dash with hard block at (6,5) → falls back to (6,5)? NO — refused entirely (hard block in PATH). Validate.
Dash with hard block at (7,5) → falls back to single-cell dash, lands at (6,5).
Cooldown: dash → 3000ms wait → ready. Dash again at 2999ms → refused (no cooldown burn for refused dashes).
Bomber dashing while carrying bomb (canThrow) → refused.
Dash + pickup at (7,5) and pickup at (6,5) → only (7,5) collected (landing cell only).
DETERMINISM: dash mechanics are deterministic per (input + dt + bomber state). Bot-vs-bot regression resolves; potentially shorter rounds as Coward bots escape more.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Dash with longer range (3+ cells). 2-cell range is the design.
Multi-direction dash (e.g. dash diagonally). 4-cardinal only.
Charged dash (hold Shift to charge longer dash). Out — instant button-press only.
Multiple dashes stacked via pickup. No 'dash-up' pickup; the universal 3s cooldown is the design.
Dash voice slot in vocal synth (silent dash in v1).
Dash through bombs detonates them (chain-trigger interaction). Bombs pass-through without interaction.
Dash WHILE airborne (already dashing). One dash at a time.
Dash-attack (dash-through opponent causes damage). No combat mechanic from dash.
